latest_action.text: Motion by Senator Schumer to reconsider, under the order of 10/9/2025, not having voted on the prevailing side, the vote by which the third cloture motion on the motion to proceed to S. 2882 was not invoked (Record Vote No. 557) entered in Senate.

card.summary: S. 2882 is a legislative measure that provides temporary funding for federal agencies through October 31, 2025, to prevent a government shutdown at the start of fiscal year 2026. Beyond short-term agency funding at fiscal year 2025 levels, the bill permanently extends expanded health insurance premium tax credits, repeals specific health care and Medicaid funding reductions from a prior law, provides supplemental funding for federal security and the U.S. Marshals Service, and temporarily extends various expiring programs related to health, veterans affairs, agriculture, and national security through October 31, 2025.
